summary: Built the terrain module from the stub (files under /home/user/SimBuild/src/modules/terrain/: index.js, data.js, mesh.js, material.js, water.js, detail.js, showcase.js, gen/noise.js, gen/heightmap.js). Heightfield: 513² deterministic generator (ctx.rng-seeded simplex, warped fbm plains, hill ring, ridged mountains E/N/S, meandering river carved by true polyline distance from the east range to a west estuary/coast with beach, an island, west-corner headlands, droplet hydraulic erosion masked to hills/mountains, flow + cavity-AO maps). City area plains: mean slope 4.7%, 89% of plains cells under 8%, still rolling. world.terrain fully implemented and verified in-page (getHeight bilinear, getNormal, getSlope, isWater, marching+bisection raycast used by camera.screenToGround, modify raise/lower/flatten/smooth with partial normal/AO rebuild, chunk-bound refresh, version bump and terrain:changed event); also exposes world.terrain.features (river.zAt/halfWidthAt, coast.xAt, island) for roads/democity. Rendering: 16x16 chunks of 32 cells as 3 instanced patch meshes (LOD 32/16/8 cells, skirts, per-chunk frustum culling + distance LOD, heights fetched from an R32F texture in the vertex shader so edits are a texture upload), separate skirt-less shadow/reflection proxies (LOD1/LOD2) that render only in CSM shadow passes and the water reflection, custom depth material with per-LOD drop to avoid coarse-vs-fine acne. Material: MeshStandardMaterial+onBeforeCompile splat of 5 CC0 Poly Haven sets (aerial_grass_rock coarse, leafy_grass fine/micro, brown_mud_leaves_01, rock_face triplanar, aerial_beach_01) blended by slope/height/flow/macro noise, aperiodic coarse tiling, macro colour variation (lush/dry/altitude), detail normals, derivative-based erosion bump on rock, wet shoreline, underwater tint, cavity AO, hooked into the environment's CSM/height-fog. Water: camera-following disc at sea level with planar reflection (oblique clip, half-res HalfFloat RT, refreshed only when camera/time/sun change, alpha-composited over the environment's equirect sky LUT), depth tint and shore transparency from the height texture, animated foam, scrolling ripple normals, sun glints, horizon convergence, deep sea beyond the map edge. Near-camera instanced grass tufts (1 draw call, deterministic hash placement, wind sway, 3-variant procedural blade atlas). Showcase adds 'valley' and 'coast' presets derived from the generated features. Manifest gained 5 CC0 entries (fetched). Core/other-module requests written to /home/user/SimBuild/docs/core-requests/terrain.md (environment sky dome must follow the rendering camera; init order; camera raycaster allocation). Final gauntlet round dev2 (shots/terrain/rdev2/summary.json): 16/16 shots OK, module status ready in all, 0 console errors, max 12 draw calls, max 196,152 triangles; fps under SwiftShader is 0 (frames take 3-5 s at 1080p; six shots timed out under concurrent builder load and were re-shot individually, summary rebuilt from the per-shot JSONs). No git commits made.
